def test_maximum():
    # k == 0 returns an empty list
    assert maximum([1, 2, 3], 0) == []

    # basic case: returns k largest elements in ascending order
    assert maximum([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) == [4, 5]
    assert maximum([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3) == [3, 4, 5]

    # unsorted input array
    assert maximum([9, 1, 8, 2, 7], 2) == [8, 9]

    # negative numbers
    assert maximum([-1, -5, -3, -2], 2) == [-3, -2]

    # duplicates
    assert maximum([5, 5, 3, 3, 5], 2) == [5, 5]

    # k equals length of array -> all elements sorted ascending
    assert maximum([3, 1, 2], 3) == [1, 2, 3]

    # k greater than length of array -> all elements sorted ascending
    assert maximum([3, 1, 2], 5) == [1, 2, 3]

    # single element array
    assert maximum([7], 1) == [7]

    # k == 0 on empty array
    assert maximum([], 0) == []
